$comment: AIP-70 GLOSSARY vocabulary. `terms`: one meaning per term, its owning AIP, and what it never means. `deprecated`: aliases reported by scripts/check-names.mjs (report only).

terms.means: an agent binary driven by a host (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Hermes) and its manifest
terms.neverMeans: a bridge into a foreign framework; a session preset

terms.means: the projection of an agentproto handle into a foreign framework (Mastra, AI SDK)
an inward bridge from agentproto to an external API, CLI, MCP server or SDK
an agent holding a role in an organization
terms.neverMeans: the human who controls a host (say user); the principal holding a host's credential (say host operator); the host user's name for a session (say operator label); a runtime strategy (the shared in-process shell is the behaviour of `runtime.kind: in-process`)

terms.means: the human who owns and controls a host and its sessions

the principal that holds a host's own credential: the user, or a client acting for them (for example a command line or a desktop app); written "the operator" inside AIP-46 and AIP-71, where no AIP-9 operator appears
the identity-ref a grant names and a request resolves to (a host operator, a session, `anonymous`, an AIP-9 operator, a user)
one running (or ended) harness invocation managed by a host
terms.neverMeans: a terminal, a browser instance, an ACP wire session (say "ACP session")

terms.means: free text attached for display to a session, a spawn request or an auth profile; a grant never matches it
terms.neverMeans: an operator label; the `label:` scope form, which matches the operator label

terms.means: the durable name only the host operator, or the host itself, assigns to a session or a lineage, matched by `label:` scopes and `session-label://` principals
terms.neverMeans: a label; a session id; an AIP-9 operator, or its slug

terms.means: the `contextSettings` block of a session: the context floor, the absolute compaction threshold and the reservation of compaction to the operator, each layered as its own axis
terms.neverMeans: the `contextProfile` axis of a session config; a prompt's context window

terms.means: how a session runs: harness, model, effort, posture, context, route, auth profile, retry, fallback
a named, saved session config
terms.neverMeans: a gateway; a harness manifest; a per-harness default overlay (say harness defaults, the `host` layer of AIP-46 §Layers)

terms.means: a backend endpoint a harness can be pointed at (Anthropic-compatible, OpenAI-compatible)
a named reference to the credential a session bills or authenticates through
terms.neverMeans: a context setting; a browser identity; a daemon config overlay (say config profile)

terms.means: the builder of a model (the `vendor` in a `vendor/product` model id)
a namespaced key (`metadata.<vendor>`) a file carries for one host, which the spec does not define and which other hosts MUST tolerate
terms.neverMeans: a model vendor (say vendor); a field the owning AIP defines

terms.means: the party that serves and bills a model
terms.neverMeans: the model builder; an inference endpoint (AIP-61, always qualified); a gateway; an HTTP route

terms.means: the billing path a model is reached through (an `@<route>` suffix on a model id)
an AIP-38 access document: grants, limits, requirements
terms.neverMeans: a completion check, a retry rule, settings, a drive or model allow list (say grant)

terms.means: a check that passes or fails at a boundary: the delegation spawn gate of AIP-46, a completion check, a review verdict
what a session may do without asking (plan, accept-edits, bypass, read-only)
a harness-native, mutually exclusive operation profile declared in an AIP-45 manifest
terms.neverMeans: posture; a session lifetime; how a session is billed (billing basis); an action

terms.means: an AIP-47 organizational role (intent, never permission)
terms.neverMeans: an access role; a position; a model slot

terms.means: a permission tier of a human or agent inside a host's organization (owner, admin, editor, viewer), evaluated by AIP-38 policy
terms.neverMeans: an AIP-47 role; a session's delegation authority, which is its bound agent's `delegates_to` (AIP-46 §Delegation)

terms.means: a seat in an organization that one operator holds at a time
a host-local file that names a profile (harness, model, prompt) for a delegated session; the daemon's own `roles` directory holds them
terms.neverMeans: an AIP-47 role; an access role

terms.means: a logical model name resolved per host (review.small, judge.session)
a saved, ordered, declarative selection over a registry family
the in-memory catalog of handles of one family
the data a family's registry serves (model prices, context sizes)
an AIP-64 installable capability bundle
terms.neverMeans: an AIP-57 routing table; a host-local bundle of imported MCP servers and skills (say bundle)

terms.means: an AIP-57 map from a keyspace to targets
the AIP-48 multi-agent execution kernel
the daemon that runs sessions, runs and their state on a machine
an AIP-34 workspace node, including the `x.workspace` doctypes
the nearest declared AIP-34 node whose folder contains a session's AIP-46 `ground`; walls, policy and memory visibility apply to it
terms.neverMeans: an operator's home (operators are not scoped, sessions are); a policy scope string

terms.means: the scratch directory a run gets
a PTY process driven through a host
terms.neverMeans: a session; the end state of a lifecycle (say "end state")

terms.means: one running browser driven through AIP-63
a saved browser login state

deprecated.use: harness defaults (the `host` layer of AIP-46 §Layers), or a session preset with `defaultFor`
agent (a built-in AIP-42 agent named by `agent`)
